title: An Enigma machine
alt: An Enigma machine in an open wooden box, seen from above: a panel of round lamp windows at the top, three numbered rotor wheels in the middle, a row of lamps with one lit, and a keyboard of round keys at the bottom with a finger pressing one.
author: ArnoldReinhold
description: Enigma Machine A16672 with cover open. The "L" key is depressed and the "D" light is lit. Item on display at the MIT Flea Market, held monthly from April to October on the MIT campus.
